title: AI Fabric End-to-End Architecture & Sizing Guide: Scale-Up (NVLink 4/5) vs. Scale-Out (IB NDR/XDR vs. RoCEv2), GPUDirect RDMA, PFC+ECN+DCQCN Buffer Math & algbw/busbw Conversion

workload_basis.cluster_scale: 512 GPUs (64 Nodes x 8 GPUs) with 8x 400G NICs per Node (50 GB/s line rate per NIC)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Misconfigured PCIe ACS Enabled / Missing dmabuf GPUDirect RDMA (CPU Root Complex Detour)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Severe deployment misconfiguration; immediately disable PCIe ACS and load dmabuf/nvidia-peermem

tiers.tier: Tier 2: GPUDirect RDMA + Legacy 5-Tuple Static ECMP + Pure PFC (Hash Polarization & Pause Storms)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Unacceptable for >64 GPU clusters due to elephant-flow collisions and PFC head-of-line blocking

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Rail-Optimized RoCEv2 + GPUDirect RDMA + ECN-First DCQCN + DLB + 200ms PFC Watchdog
tiers.recommended_scenario: High-ROI open Ethernet standard for 64-to-1,024 GPU inference, PD disaggregation, and post-training

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Intra-Node NVLink + Scale-Out IB NDR/XDR (Adaptive Routing + SHARP) or Spectrum-X/UEC Packet Spraying
tiers.recommended_scenario: Flagship multi-tenant AI factory standard delivering 96.4% wire efficiency and 2.37x Goodput over Tier 1
